cards.example_en: We may run out of paper this afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 今天下午纸可能会用完。

cards.example_en: They search for the lost dog in the park.
cards.example_zh: 他们在公园里搜寻走失的狗。

cards.example_en: We will send for a doctor if the pain grows.
cards.example_zh: 如果疼痛加重，我们会派人去请医生。

cards.example_en: They set about cleaning the lab.
cards.example_zh: 他们着手打扫实验室。

cards.example_en: Set aside twenty minutes for dictation.
cards.example_zh: 留出二十分钟听写。

cards.example_en: At the end they set the bird free.
cards.example_zh: 最后他们把鸟放走。

cards.example_en: We set off for the museum at eight.
cards.example_zh: 我们八点出发去博物馆。

cards.example_en: They set out early with a small bag.
cards.example_zh: 他们带一个小包很早动身。

cards.example_en: The school will set up a reading club.
cards.example_zh: 学校将建立一个读书社团。

cards.example_en: Please settle down and open your books.
cards.example_zh: 请安静下来，把书打开。

cards.example_en: Do not show off a high score.
cards.example_zh: 不要炫耀高分。

cards.example_en: Please show up ten minutes early.
cards.example_zh: 请早十分钟露面。

cards.example_en: May I speak to Mr Chen?
cards.example_zh: 我可以和陈老师说话吗？

cards.example_en: The letters UN stand for an organisation.
cards.example_zh: 字母 UN 代表一个组织。

cards.example_en: Her opening line will stand out.
cards.example_zh: 她的开头一句会显得突出。

cards.example_en: Do not stare at strangers on the bus.
cards.example_zh: 不要在公交车上盯着陌生人看。

cards.example_en: Stick to your plan, and do a little each day.
cards.example_zh: 坚持你的计划，每天做一点。

cards.example_en: She may succeed in the speech contest.
cards.example_zh: 她可能成功地做成演讲比赛。

cards.example_en: Many cities suffer from traffic jams.
cards.example_zh: 许多城市受交通堵塞折磨。

cards.example_en: Let us take a break and drink some water.
cards.example_zh: 我们休息片刻，喝点水。

cards.example_en: He will take a chance and enter the contest.
cards.example_zh: 他将碰碰运气，报名参赛。

cards.example_en: May I take a photo of the bridge?
cards.example_zh: 我可以给这座桥拍照吗？

cards.example_en: Grandpa will take a walk after breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷早饭后会去走走。

cards.example_en: We must take action to save water.
cards.example_zh: 我们必须采取行动节约用水。

cards.example_en: Take advantage of the quiet morning.
cards.example_zh: 利用安静的早晨。

cards.example_en: Take advice before you choose a course.
cards.example_zh: 选课前先听从劝告。

cards.example_en: The boy may take after his father.
cards.example_zh: 这个男孩可能长得像他父亲。

cards.example_en: Take care on the icy road.
cards.example_zh: 结冰的路上要保重。

cards.example_en: I take care of the class plants.
cards.example_zh: 我照料班里的植物。

cards.example_en: Lin will take charge of the stage lights.
cards.example_zh: 林将负责掌管舞台灯光。

cards.example_en: Try to take control of your revision plan.
cards.example_zh: 尽量掌控你的复习计划。

cards.example_en: The new rule will take effect in May.
cards.example_zh: 新规则将在五月生效。

cards.example_en: We take exercise on the playground.
cards.example_zh: 我们在操场上锻炼身体。

cards.example_en: I cannot take in so many names at once.
cards.example_zh: 我无法一下子理解吸收这么多名字。

cards.example_en: They take an interest in local history.
cards.example_zh: 他们对本地历史发生兴趣。

cards.example_en: The school will take measures to cut waste.
cards.example_zh: 学校将采取措施减少浪费。

cards.example_en: I take notes while the teacher talks.
cards.example_zh: 老师讲课时我做笔记。

cards.example_en: Please take notice of the red sign.
cards.example_zh: 请注意到那块红色告示。

cards.example_en: The plane will take off in ten minutes.
cards.example_zh: 飞机十分钟后起飞。

cards.example_en: She may take on more club duties.
cards.example_zh: 她可能会承担起更多社团事务。

cards.example_en: Who will take over as captain?
cards.example_zh: 谁来接管队长一职？

cards.example_en: I will take part in the singing contest.
cards.example_zh: 我将参加歌唱比赛。

cards.example_en: The meeting will take place in Room 3.
cards.example_zh: 会议将在 3 号房间举行。

cards.example_en: The school will take pride in its choir.
cards.example_zh: 学校会为合唱团感到自豪。

cards.example_en: A careful essay will take time.
cards.example_zh: 一篇仔细的文章会花时间。

cards.example_en: We take turns to clean the blackboard.
cards.example_zh: 我们轮流擦黑板。

cards.example_en: She wants to take up painting.
cards.example_zh: 她想开始学画画。
